title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
authors: S. Yao, J. Zhao, D. Yu, N. Du, I. Shafran, K. Narasimhan, Y. Cao
before: Reasoning and tool use were separate lines: chain-of-thought thought, WebGPT acted.
problem: Pure reasoning hallucinates facts; pure acting has no plan.
breakthrough: Interleave them in one loop: a thought, an action, an observation, repeat.
why: This loop is the skeleton of essentially every agent framework that followed.
next: Reflexion added memory, Toolformer learned the calls, and coding agents industrialised it.
inherits: The thought-action-observation cycle at the heart of agents.
